visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair pulled back in a bun sits at a round light-wood table in a bright indoor living room, talking to two young girls. One girl wears a white shirt and the other a light green floral dress; they lean on the table with wide eyes. (2) The woman holds up two printed photographs of men, one younger with short hair and one with longer hair, placing them on blue mats alongside lumps of flesh-colored clay. The girls begin touching the clay with their small hands. (3) The girls use their palms to flatten the clay on the blue mats, mimicking the woman's pressing motions. An orange and white cat walks across the background floor near a white slide. (4) Small wooden bowls containing googly eyes, buttons, and twigs are placed on the table. The girls carefully press large googly eyes into the clay faces and stick thin dark twigs on top for hair. (5) The girl in the green dress rolls a pink lump of clay into a flat circle for a shirt, while the other girl adds purple and red heart-shaped paper cutouts to the scene. (6) The girls press their hands onto blue ink pads and then stamp their handprints onto the cardboard base next to the clay portraits. (7) A man with long hair tied back crouches by a staircase, receiving one of the finished boards from the girls; he smiles broadly while examining the art. (8) A second man wearing glasses and a tan t-shirt stands near the stairs, laughing as the girls present him with his clay portrait and a printed photo of himself.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-pitched, energetic voices of two young children interacting with a calm, melodic female voice. A light, upbeat acoustic guitar and glockenspiel BGM plays consistently at a moderate volume. (2) As the children start working with clay, rhythmic 'thud' sounds of hands hitting the table are heard, punctuated by a cat's soft meow in the background. The female adult uses exaggerated, playful intonation to guide them. (3) Soft rustling of plastic wrap and the clicking of small objects being moved are audible. The BGM maintains a steady, happy tempo as the girls' voices become more focused and slightly quieter. (4) Laughter breaks out as they discuss 'Papa's face,' followed by the sharp 'pop' of a sound effect for emphasis. (5) The final phase features deeper male voices reacting with surprise and joy ('Wow!'), characterized by high vocal arousal and positive valence, mixed with the children's proud, excited shouting and the swelling volume of the cheerful BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a heartwarming family moment where two young children create handmade Father's Day gifts, showcasing their creativity and the joyful reaction of their parents.
